personalInfo.statement: I am Shaan Patel, a student at UNC Charlotte studying Computer Science with a concentration in Cybersecurity.
personalInfo.personalBackground: I am Shaan Patel, a student at UNC Charlotte studying Computer Science with a concentration in Cybersecurity.
personalInfo.professionalBackground: I am interested in cybersecurity, ethical hacking, and learning how technology can be used to protect people and organizations. I have experience working with children as a Youth Development Leader at the YMCA, where I helped supervise groups and maintain a safe environment.
personalInfo.academicBackground: I am studying Computer Science at UNC Charlotte and focusing on cybersecurity. My coursework has helped me build skills in programming, databases, and technology.
personalInfo.primaryWorkLocation: Home or campus, depending on the assignment.
personalInfo.interests: I enjoy cybersecurity, technology, drawing, and electronic music. I also enjoy watching animated shows, including Invincible, and listening to artists such as Bunii.
